title: NetworkManager bridge without carrier shows endless connecting animation
line: A bridge or bond that waits for a cable on one of its ports now says "Waiting for a connected port" instead of spinning forever in the Networks widget and tray.
explanation: NetworkManager keeps a bridge or bond that uses DHCP in the IP configuration state until one of its ports has a carrier, so its connection stays 'activating' for as long as the cable is unplugged. The widget showed every activating connection with a busy indicator and 'Setting network address', and the tray icon showed its busy ring, so both spun forever. The change adds UiUtils::isWaitingForCarrier() (bridge or bond in IP config without carrier); the model exposes it as a WaitingForCarrier role, updated on device state and carrier changes, the item then reads 'Waiting for a connected port' without a spinner, and the tray icon no longer counts such connections as connecting.

commits.message:
applet: don't show a bridge waiting for a port link as connecting

NetworkManager keeps a bridge or bond using DHCP in IP configuration
until one of its ports gets a carrier, so the widget and its tray icon
spun forever. Show that it waits for a connected port, without spinner.

BUG: 528968
